segments.text:
V. 39.
Ye—Jews in general; Men of Jeruſalem in particular: Shall not ſee me from this time—Which includes the ſhort Space till his Death, till, after a long Interval of Deſolation and Miſery, ye ſay, Bleſſed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord—Ye receive me with joyful and thankful Hearts. This alſo ſhall be accompliſhed in its Seaſon.
